easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcom triggers due to Conspiracy, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Quicksmith Genius, causing you to draw a card and discard a card.
Repeat from step 2.
